mapper.select: SELECT P.PLAN_ID, P.TITLE, P.REGION_CODE, R.REGION_NAME, P.START_DATE, P.END_DATE, P.VISIBILITY, P.VERSION_NO FROM TRAVEL_PLAN P JOIN REGION_MASTER R ON R.REGION_CODE = P.REGION_CODE WHERE P.PLAN_ID = #{planId} AND P.OWNER_MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND P.PLAN_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT P.PLAN_ID, P.TITLE, P.REGION_CODE, R.REGION_NAME, P.START_DATE, P.END_DATE, P.VISIBILITY, P.VERSION_NO FROM TRAVEL_PLAN P JOIN REGION_MASTER R ON R.REGION_CODE = P.REGION_CODE WHERE P.PLAN_ID = #{planId} AND P.PLAN_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND ( P.OWNER_MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PLAN_MEMBER PM WHERE PM.PLAN_ID = P.PLAN_ID AND PM.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND PM.PARTICIPANT_TYPE = 'INVITEE' ) )
